_readme: DRAFT wording for the game. Rewrite freely. Every company and person here is invented as a placeholder. 'giants' are the large companies the start-ups try to get into: each needs an id, a name, a need, and four 'people' in door order (manager, security, procurement, executive). 'doors' are the short labels for those four doors. 'messages' are the three things a start-up can lead with; which one each giant cares about is drawn at random every game. 'moves' holds the name and one-line description of each marketing move (what a move costs and how often it works is in js/config.js). 'sellers' are the start-ups: id, name, tagline.
rules: You run a start-up. Pick one large company and get inside it: four people have to say yes.
Each round you have a small marketing budget. Every move shows what it costs and its chance of opening the next door.
Your network is in this room. Everyone knows one person inside one company. Find the classmate who knows yours.
doorWho: the manager who has the problem
